integrity: Complete infinite proof included; finite checker is corroboration rather than proof.
scientific_limitations: Only Dyck paths of maximum height two and zero-prefix-normality; semigroup number sequence, old Dyck-semigroup map, and genus/conductor inequality are known. No uniqueness or closed form for all genera is claimed; independent verification not performed.
title: Prefix-normal height-two Dyck words encode conductor-bounded numerical semigroups
